d: Amid the long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto 6, discover how cars reshaped society, transformed industries, and helped define the modern world. In the first episode of Cars That Changed History from National Geographic, learn all about muscle cars. From Prohibition-era bootleggers to the Ford Mustang and Pontiac GTO, muscle cars transformed American motoring. Fierce rivalries, powerful V-8 engines, and a hunger for speed created a new breed of performance car that captured the imagination of a nation.
